capabilities: Poll Skim for newly created highlights every 1.5 seconds
Copy each highlight to the clipboard as a markdown card
Link back to the exact PDF page via a pXX link
Toggle listening from the status bar, ribbon icon, or command palette
disambiguation: Works only with the Skim PDF reader on macOS, not with PDF highlights in general.
extras: macOS-only and desktop-only (uses AppleScript to talk to Skim); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Getting PDF highlights from Skim into notes normally takes manual copying and loses the link back to the source page.

relations.evidence: The plugin polls Skim from within your note-taking app every 1.5 seconds

summary: Watches the Skim PDF reader for new highlights and copies each as a markdown card with a back-link to the PDF page.
